reported_success.quote: this study replicates and extends previous research uniquely relating delay discounting and behavioral economic demand variables with cannabis use.

notes: The neutral locator names relationships of both discounting and demand with symptom count, without a particular commodity. Extracted the focal unique discounting association discussed by each paper. Original discounting is monetary AUC; replication focal discounting is cannabis log(k), a changed commodity and scoring direction. The same replication Table 4 also prints monetary discounting β=.19, p=.18, and cannabis demand β=.21, p=.15; original demand β=0.20, p=0.10. These are distinct tests and are not substituted into the focal ES/p pair. Replication locator p.31 could not be reconciled with journal pagination 33–40; the matching outcome and regression were located independently in Table 4. Authors describe replication success despite the monetary-discounting association not remaining uniquely significant. Both full-text titles and DOIs verified against assigned references.
